title: Dual Fourier support
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over the field with two elements, and let $f:V\to\mathbb R$. Its dual Fourier support is the set of linear functionals on $V$ whose dual Fourier coefficient for $f$ is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-dimensional vector space $V$ over the field with two elements
